lead: AI product photography turns one clear photo into a new setting, a white image for your product page, or a person wearing the item. Check each result against what you ship.

A first image usually needs pure white and nothing extra. Later photos can show use, size, or a close detail. On your own store, match the background you already use so the row of photos stays tidy. Product photos come out square, which fits a product page and a social post.

sections.h2: How Do I Check a Photo Before I Publish It?
paras: Put the image next to the product in your hand. Compare color, shape, the size of each part, logos, and how many parts there are.

Zoom in on labels, buttons, and edges. If something looks wrong, do not hide it with a caption. Make the image again with a clearer sentence or a sharper photo. Do not ask for printed words, famous faces, or logos you do not own. The [Content Policy](/content) says what can be uploaded. Uploads and results stay in your account and are not shown publicly.
